_comment: Accepted exceptions to the client-medical-logic rule (R2.7, ADR-060). Empty: no screen decides anything medical today, so the guard is a plain gate. It was empty under the old native-readiness rules too, which is what made repointing it cheap. Adding an entry is a deliberate, reviewable decision that one screen may hold medical logic a Flutter client cannot share; it is not a way to make the build pass.
